home.name: Daniil Tarasov
home.news: Tarasov has unexpectedly been getting more playing time in recent weeks, emerging as one of the NHL's most consistent goalies this season. The 27-year-old is coming off a 31-save performance for his second shutout of the season in a 2-0 win over the Tampa Bay Lightning. In nine games (3-3-2), Tarasov has a stellar 1.84 GAA and a .931 SV%.

home.name: Connor Hellebuyck
home.news: Hellebuyck has been excellent since joining the Devils, yet to lose a game (7-0-0), and will return to the crease on Wednesday. The 33-year-old American goalie is coming off his busiest outing of the season, saving 42 of 46 shots (.913 SV%) in a 7-4 win over the Washington Capitals. In his last three games (3-0-0), Hellebuyck has a 2.01 GAA and .938 SV%. The Devils enter Wednesday's game as -162 home favourites against a Montreal Canadiens team that has been outscored 7-2 in their past two games (0-2-0).
